description: Saves the text to paste under an illustrated story when they post it, which shows in the studio's Post text tab (Fuzzframe writes none for a story: you do). Write it from the finished story: a line that adds to it, never the script again, and a few hashtags about the subject (no #fyp, #viral or app names). Call it once the MP4 is there, with the same captions you give them in the chat, or when they ask for their post text. Text they wrote themselves in the studio is replaced only when they ask. Free.

everywhere.description: One caption that fits every platform (YouTube Shorts, X, Facebook): at most 280 characters, 3 to 5 hashtags at its end

instagram.description: The Instagram Reels caption, hashtags at its end

replace_theirs.description: true only when they asked to replace post text they wrote themselves

tiktok.description: The TikTok caption, hashtags at its end

title.description: The video's title for the post
